Overview.Name: Susmita Dora
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cucumber slices
Option 2: Chicken pan fried (120 g) + small fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Chicken pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soya bean and tofu completely as requested.
Start meals with chicken, eggs or paneer before eating rice.
For stress or late-night cravings, drink water or eat curd first and wait 10 minutes.
During social gatherings, eat your regular meal before outside food.
Keep dinner lighter to improve digestion, recovery and body composition.
